project.styleDefinitionBrief: Unity 5 flat dark theme: solid #2b2b2b panels, #3d9eff brand blue, zero rounded corners, dense professional layout, full JS interactivity

styleContinuityAnchors.colorSystem: dark #191919 base, #2b2b2b panels, #323232 toolbar, #3d9eff brand, selected #2c5f8a, axis X=#e74c4c Y=#49b86e Z=#3d9eff
styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: ZERO rounded corners on panels/containers. Flat square everything. max 2px radius on small controls.
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Segoe UI for UI, Consolas for code. Body 12px, Labels 11px, Status 10px. Monospace for data values.
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: tight 2/4/6/8/10/12/16/20/24/32. Panel padding 6-8px. Tool buttons 26x26. Menu bar 20px height.
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: solid flat panels, #111 borders, #1c1c1c inputs, flat buttons #333 bg, tab bars with blue bottom border on active
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: 1px solid #111 borders only. No shadows on static elements. No blur. No transparency.
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: text-based icons and simple shapes, monochrome matching text color. No decorative images.
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: JS-driven: collapsible sections, tab switching, panel resizing, drag interactions, real-time slider updates, tree expand/collapse, filter toggles.

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: Unity-style: 20px menu bar (#2a2a2a) + 30px toolbar (#323232). Play/Pause/Stop in menu bar.
sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: brand #3d9eff, selected #2c5f8a, semantic green/yellow/red for console
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: Segoe UI + Consolas. Labels 11px, body 12px, console 10px Consolas.
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: 1px solid #111 borders. Flat solid colors. No shadows.
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: flat buttons, #2c5f8a bg for primary actions, #333 bg for secondary
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: tight spacing, 8px grid. Inspector label 110px width. Inputs 55px.
